data.caution: Resin code 2 and a bottle shape don't prove it's safe to reuse or to hold food. Bottles with unknown or chemical contents can't follow this food bottle guide.
data.reason: You confirmed what this clean HDPE bottle held and that your collector accepts it, so it can go to Recycle. Resin code 2 doesn't guarantee it's safe to reuse or that every facility accepts it.

steps: Confirm that it's HDPE (code 2) and that it held food or drink. Don't use this guide for bottles that held chemicals or unknown contents.
Empty it, rinse out food residue as the collector asks, and sort it by type.
Hand it to a collector you confirmed accepts HDPE in this condition. Don't assume a used bottle is safe to refill.
